name: Oracle Depthlord
body:
There are beings who attempt to harness strange esoterica and others who find it forced upon them by fortune. In either case, these depthlords are known and feared by all who dwell in the darkness.

Skills

A depthlord adds Knowledge (dungeoneering), Knowledge (engineering), and Use Magic Device to her list of class skills.

This replaces the bonus skills the depthlord gains from her mystery.

Deep Arcana (Ex)

At 2nd level, the depthlord’s connection to ancient secrets infuses her mind with strange and powerful magic. She selects one spell from the psychic spell list that is at least one level lower than the highest-level oracle spell she can cast. The depthlord gains this as a bonus spell known. The spell is treated as one level higher than its true level for all purposes. The depthlord may choose an additional spell at 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 18th levels.

This ability replaces the bonus spells she would normally gain at these levels from her chosen mystery.

Revelations

A depthlord can select the following revelations regardless of her chosen mystery: Maker-Forged Resilience: The depthlord gains spell resistance equal to 11 + her depthlord level. She can lower or reactivate this spell resistance as a move action.

Outertech Infusion

The depthlord gains Transcendent Spell* as a bonus feat and may apply this metamagic feat to her spells without modifying the level or casting time.

Mysteries

The following oracle mysteries complement the depthlord archetype: Apocalypse, Battle, Dark Tapestry, Dragon, Lore, and Metal.

Primal Visionary

The ancient magics of otherworldly beings remain potent in certain parts of the world, with this strange arcana infusing individuals with uncanny abilities. Be they chosen emissaries of the fey or simply unwary souls blessed by inhuman patrons, primal visionaries are entities with deep connections to faraway realms.

Spells Known: Rather than learning spells from the cleric spell list, a primal visionary learns spells from the druid spell list. In addition, a primal visionary adds any spells on the cleric spell list which could be learned by an oracle but not a cleric to her druid spell list.

This replaces the oracle’s normal spell list.

Primal Secrets: In addition to revelations from their chosen mystery, a primal visionary can choose from the following revelations:

Fey Familiarity (Ex)

The oracle gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against the spell-like and supernatural abilities of fey. This bonus also applies to spells and effects that utilize or target plants, such as blight, entangle, spike growth, and warp wood.

Free Step (Su)

The oracle gains the druid’s woodland stride and trackless step class features.

Floral Companion (Ex)

The oracle gains a plant companion as the treesinger druid archetype, using her oracle level as her druid level.

Primordial Tongue (Su)

The oracle gains Sylvan or Aklo as a bonus language and is treated as constantly being under the effects of a speak with animals spell.

Song of the Eldest (Su)

The oracle gains the ability to use bardic performance as a bard of her oracle level, save that she can only use the countersong, fascinate, suggestion, dirge of doom, and mass suggestion performances. The oracle must be at least 7th level before selecting this revelation.

Mysteries: The following oracle mysteries complement the primal visionary archetype: Ancestor, Lore, Nature, Time.
